task.title: Relics: benchmark a 1 MiB body edit and 16 MiB of live bodies
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M67). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Two relic limits have no measurement behind them. The large-relic edit in the benchmark changes a 524-byte part, not a 1 MiB body. Nothing measures a relic holding 16 MiB of live bodies.

## Wanted

Add both scenarios to `scripts/benchmark.sh --relics`.

## Done when

- Both scenarios run and report timings and storage.
- The limits table in the docs cites them.
